title: Detailed cupcake
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <!-- wrapper pleats -->
  <path d='M38 55 L40 88' stroke='#A57CC4' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>

  <rect x='28' y='52' width='44' height='7' rx='3' fill='#9B6EC0'/>
  <!-- bottom rim -->
  <rect x='34' y='85' width='32' height='5' rx='2' fill='#9B6EC0'/>
  <!-- frosting swirl - base layer -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='22' ry='10' fill='#FF9BC1'/>
  <!-- frosting middle -->
  <path d='M28 52 Q28 38 38 34 Q42 28 50 30 Q58 28 62 34 Q72 38 72 52 Q66 44 50 44 Q34 44 28 52 Z' fill='#FFB3D1'/>

  <!-- cherry stem -->
  <path d='M50 20 Q52 10 58 8' stroke='#4CAF50' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>

  <ellipse cx='61' cy='10' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#66DD66' transform='rotate(-20 61 10)'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='17' r='7' fill='#E8192C'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='15' r='2.5' fill='#FF6B78'/>
  <!-- sprinkles on frosting -->
  <rect x='34' y='44' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFE44D' transform='rotate(-25 36 45)'/>
  <rect x='60' y='46' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#66DD66' transform='rotate(15 62 47)'/>

  <rect x='30' y='48' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#4DCCFF' transform='rotate(60 32 49)'/>
  <rect x='63' y='38' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FF9BC1' transform='rotate(-50 65 39)'/>
  <rect x='47' y='48' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#66DD66' transform='rotate(10 49 49)'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='42' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#FFE44D'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='42' r='1.5' fill='#FF9BC1'/>
</svg>
